mapper.sql: r.status = 3 AND r.trace_code IS NOT NULL AND (r.quality_status IS NULL OR r.quality_status <> 2)
mapper.select: SELECT r.reta_batch_id AS retaBatchId, r.trace_code AS traceCode, r.product_code AS productCode, r.product_form AS productForm, r.spec_grade AS specGrade, r.quality_status AS qualityStatus, r.price AS price, r.image_url AS imageUrl, fm.source_type AS sourceType FROM reta_batch r LEFT JOIN whol_batch w ON w.batch_no = r.up_batch_no AND w.node_id = r.up_node_id LEFT JOIN froz_batch f ON f.batch_no = w.up_batch_no AND f.node_id = w.up_node_id LEFT JOIN farm_batch fm ON fm.batch_no = f.up_batch_no AND fm.node_id = f.up_node_id WHERE r.reta_batch_id = #{retaBatchId}
SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(r.product_form, ''), '冻虾') AS name, COUNT(*) AS value FROM reta_batch r WHERE GROUP BY COALESCE(NULLIF(r.product_form, ''), '冻虾')

SELECT b.reta_batch_id, b.node_id, b.batch_no, b.up_batch_no, b.breed, b.product_type, b.status, b.create_time, n.node_id AS n_node_id, n.name AS n_name, n.code AS n_code, n.address AS n_address, n.corporation AS n_corporation, n.telephone AS n_telephone, n.business_id AS n_business_id FROM reta_batch b LEFT JOIN node_info n ON n.node_id = b.node_id WHERE b.status = 2 AND b.up_batch_no IN
#{no}
AND n.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{downName}, '%')
ORDER BY b.create_time DESC
